{{Quote|You see, Serphidi was once a world of superior technology&mdash;but with that technology came the urge to use it for acts of destruction! Thus was our planet torn for centuries by endless, senseless wars. Until that wonderful day when sanity prevailed and a pact was signed, one that banned technology&mdash;and united all of Serphidi under the leadership of a single king. Aggression was then sublimated into into [sic] the form of harmless, annual jousting contests.|Elglih|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 64">[[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]]</ref>}}
After centuries of devastating, high-tech wars, the [[Serp]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]] signed a '''pact''' whereby they agreed to ban high technology and live under the unified rule of a single [[King/Legends|King]]. Soon thereafter, the Serps began to hold annual combat tournaments known as [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Jousts]] as an outlet for the aggressions that had previously been used for battling one another.
